'''March 2001 Las Vegas tournament (31 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas on 31 March 2001. [[Dan Christy]] won it. It is known from Dan Christy's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1986">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-gamblers-luck-las-vegas-3-31d1986/ gamblers-luck-las-vegas-3-31], DeckTech (Dan "Mystikal" Christy, 1 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-01-gamblers-luck-las-vegas-3-31d1986/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 31 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[Dan Christy]]
